name: testimonial
description: 10 shared tools for current Testimonial.to Space REST, separate customer consent, reviewed imports/emails and bounded private single-array exports.
long_description: Focused current Space REST companion with shared task CLI and local MCP. Native customer permission stays separate from local approval; GET email is a confirmed effect. Direct read-only guard, isolated Space keys, no browser import, pagination or retry. Official hosted MCP covers wider workflows.

api_key.title: Intended Space API key
api_key.description: Private Bearer API key from the intended Testimonial.to Space. Choose this or token_file. Never paste it into a repository.

token_file.title: Private API key file
token_file.description: Absolute owner-private regular non-symlink file outside repositories. Choose instead of api_key; restrict Windows ACLs.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide and directly refuse imports, request emails, batch execution and private exports.
